run_glue_validation_summary: run the glue.py script to extract and summarize GLUE benchmark validation accuracy from fairseq training logs
extract_valid_accuracy_from_logs: extract valid_accuracy metrics from fairseq training log files grouped by run and GLUE task
compute_glue_task_averages: compute average validation accuracy across GLUE tasks including an average excluding RTE
parse_fairseq_training_logs: parse fairseq training log files using the valids module to extract checkpoint metrics
group_results_by_run_and_task: group validation accuracy results by experiment run and GLUE task name for tabular output
